title: The finite etale clopen mate has the proper-support resolution normalization
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring. Let $Q$ be a commutative square of schemes with $k:V\hookrightarrow W$, $i:S\hookrightarrow T$ quasi-compact open immersions, $r:V\to S$, $p:W\to T$ proper, and $pk=ir$. Put $W_S=W\times_T S$ with projections $b:W_S\to W$, $q:W_S\to S$, and $s=(k,r):V\to W_S$. Use module sheaves on the small etale sites, their bounded-below derived categories, exact extension by zero $J_j$, exact inverse image $G_u=u^{-1}$ and K-injective derived direct image $R_u=Ru_*$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero]. Form the cartesian open comparison $G_pJ_i\cong J_bG_q$ by transposing the open unit and let $\pi_s:F\to s_!s^{-1}F$ be the identity/zero projection of the clopen lift $s$. Let $\alpha_Q$ be their composite with $J_bJ_sG_sG_q\cong J_kG_r$. Let $\delta_F:i_!r_*F\cong p_*k_!F$ be the canonical proper-support composition identification, namely equality of these two subsheaves of $(ir)_*F=(pk)_*F$ keeping the underlying section [lem-cbc-proper-support-sheaf-composition]. Then the underived proper mate of $\alpha_Q$ is exactly $\delta$. For every $L\in D^+(V_{et},\Lambda)$, every K-injective representative $J$ of $L$, and every K-injective resolution $t:k_!J\to I$, the derived proper mate of $\alpha_Q$ is the morphism represented by
$$i_!r_*J\xrightarrow{\delta_J}p_*k_!J\xrightarrow{p_*t}p_*I.$$
Equivalently, its transpose is represented by $p^{-1}i_!r_*J\xrightarrow{\alpha_Q}k_!r^{-1}r_*J\xrightarrow{k_!\varepsilon_r}k_!J\xrightarrow{t}I$. Thus it is exactly the named normalized finite comparison of [lem-cbc-proper-open-interchange-coherence], including the refinement case $V=S$, $r=1_S$.

proof.text: First verify the geometry of the lift s:V → W ×_T S. Its composite with the first pullback projection is k. That projection is open by base change of i, and IsOpenImmersion.of_comp therefore makes s open. Its composite with the second projection is r. That projection is proper by base change of p and hence separated, so IsProper.of_comp makes s proper. An open immersion is a preimmersion, and the proper map s has closed range; IsClosedImmersion.of_isPreimmersion therefore makes s a closed immersion. This proves lift_clopen without constructing another cartesian square. The identity/zero projection is the existing direct-image unit transported through the clopen open-to-direct comparison.

proof.text: The existing open-base-change unit equation identifies the transpose of the cartesian comparison. The clopen projection satisfies G_s(pi_s)=eta_s by the direct-image triangle identity. Naturality and the canonical upper-star and open-extension compositors then give the open-unit equation for alpha. Exactness descends alpha to the bounded-below and unbounded derived categories using their localization factorization isomorphisms.

source.place: Tag 0F7B, first paragraph, comparison normalization; Tag 03S5 (open extension), with the explicit open-unit mate of the cited compatibility node.

proof.text: For a module sheaf $F$, put $A=i_!r_*F$ and $h_F=(k_!\varepsilon_{r,F})\alpha_{Q,r_*F}:G_pA\to k_!F$. Let $m_F:A\to p_*k_!F$ be its $G_p\dashv p_*$ transpose. Let $\iota_k:k_!F\hookrightarrow k_*F$ be the canonical inclusion. Under $G_k\dashv k_*$, this inclusion transposes to the inverse open unit: on an etale object factoring through $V$, its section map is identity. By Step 2, the transpose of $p_*\iota_k\,m_F$ under the composite adjunction $G_kG_p\dashv p_*k_*$ is therefore $\varepsilon_{r,F}$ after $G_kG_pA\cong G_rr_*F$. On the other hand, support composition says that $p_*\iota_k\,\delta_F$ is exactly the inclusion $i_!r_*F\hookrightarrow i_*r_*F=(ir)_*F=(pk)_*F$, keeping every section. Its composite-adjunction transpose is the same $\varepsilon_{r,F}$: restriction to $S$ removes the open extension and the remaining transpose is the direct-image counit. Thus the two maps into $p_*k_*F$ agree. The map $p_*\iota_k$ is monic, since direct image evaluates the monic inclusion on each etale test object. Cancel it to get $m_F=\delta_F$.

source.place: Tags 0F7B, 0F50 (lemma-f-shriek-composition) and 0F51 (lemma-proper-f-shriek); explicit adjunction check of the support inclusion.

proof.text:
The maps in Step 3 are natural in $F$. Consequently they commute with every differential of a complex $J$, and their degreewise equality is an equality of chain maps. In particular the termwise $G_p\dashv p_*$ transpose of $\delta_J:i_!r_*J\to p_*k_!J$ is exactly
$$h_J:G_pi_!r_*J\xrightarrow{\alpha_Q}k_!G_rr_*J\xrightarrow{k_!\varepsilon_r}k_!J.$$
This is also the defining transpose formula for the underived proper mate.

proof.text: Use the unit and counit compatibility of the induced derived adjunctions, first on the homotopy category, to prove the derived-mate unit equation. Transfer this equation to complexes using quotientCompQhIso and exact-functor factorization. For a specified K-injective complex J, rightDerivedFunctorObjQIso identifies the right-derived unit at J with its inverse. This uses only the given K-injectivity of J and I; no preservation of K-injectivity, existence of replacements, or derived-Hom computation is required. Apply the already proved derivedExact_mateEquiv_app_fac to the exact-localized square. Reuse right_unit_Q, its naturality and K-injective value equation, and exact_factor_Q from UnboundedEtaleCompactSupportComparisons; the existing private elementary factorization proofs are reused through the proved derivedComplexUnitCompatibility conjunction.

proof.text: Apply the chain-level derived-mate unit equation to J and use naturality of the right-derived unit along the specified quasi-isomorphism t. Cancel its invertible unit at I and Q(t). The resulting formula is exactly Q(delta_J followed by p_*t), with the displayed source and target isomorphisms. Naturality in the representative isomorphism e gives the formula at every L. Independently, the termwise adjunction and the ordinary mate equality identify the transposeArrow with resolutionArrow degree by degree.

proof.text: The normalized finite comparison is characterized by its derived-unit equation. Apply right-derived uniqueness to this equation and the derived-mate unit equation to identify the bounded-below mate with the named comparison. Apply the same uniqueness argument to the canonical D+/D compatibility transformations; their right-derived units agree, and the exact-functor compatibility isomorphisms are the specified ones. This proves the ambient compatibility equation as well. The argument includes identity and refinement squares without additional hypotheses. Reuse the existing right_derived_plus_unit compatibility equation from UnboundedEtaleCompactSupportComparisons. The public normalized comparison keeps its original second coherence witness; the proof uses congruence of the bundled family projection equation internally.

The normalized comparison retains its original second coherence choice; a private proof conversion uses the bundled family equation.

The statement and stmt_deps are byte-identical to the live unsplit node that Q65 created on 2026-10-22; there are no new nodes and no repair note. I read the first proof paragraph of Stacks 0F7B (more-etale.tex, lemma-shriek-proper-and-open). Its arrow g_!f'_*J = f_*g'_!J -> f_*I matches the normalization in the item and in lem-cbc-proper-open-interchange-coherence. Steps 1-4, 6 and 7 hold as written. Step 1: V x_W W_S = V because i is a monomorphism, so s is open by open base change and proper by proper-over-separated; hence s is clopen. Step 2: the last clause of the underived-compatibility node applies with (j,j',g,g_U)=(i,b,p,q) and gives G_k alpha_Q = 1. Step 3: iota_k transposes to the inverse open unit, support composition makes p_*iota_k delta_F the inclusion into (ir)_*F, and p_*iota_k is monic, which gives m_F = delta_F. Step 4: the equality passes to complexes by naturality. Step 6: the transpose t h_J gives the mate (p_*t) delta_J. Step 7: the coherence node's normalization and its refinement clause give the comparison. I checked the cases V empty, a cartesian square, a point base with a clopen component, and r = 1. FIX: Step 5 claimed that 'the actual derived adjunction' is computed by the termwise hom bijection but cited nothing that fixes the derived adjunction G_p -| R_p for module sheaves. I added the Mathlib leaf lem-sc-derived-adjunction-from-underived (Adjunction.derived and derivedε_fac_app), whose counit is induced by the underived counit, so on K-injective representatives the derived counit is the chain counit. I also added exact-functor-derived-factorization to the step's uses. Separately, I recorded four undeclared generic off-unit tools in split_report.tool_uses: extension-by-zero-exact, inverse-image-modules-exact, extension-by-zero-adjunction and right-adjoint-preserves-kinjective, all already accepted as tools on other cbc nodes.
